action.failed: That didn't work. Try again later.
connect.done.delivered: Request sent and delivered: waiting for the other instance to accept.
connect.done.linked: Link complete: the two instances are now linked.
connect.done.saved: Request saved. The other instance isn't answering right now: when it's on, use “Check now” or “Send it again”.
connect.failed: I couldn't ask to link. Try again.
connect.help.key: Paste the other home's public key here. The link becomes active when someone on the other side says yes too: it takes two to decide, and one side can't do it alone.
connect.help.ticket: Paste the other home's code here. The link becomes active when someone on the other side says yes too: it takes two to decide, and one side can't do it alone.
connect.no_discovery: On “home network” there is no discovery: paste the other home's long code here, not just the key.
connect.self: This is this instance's own key: an instance can't be linked to itself.
connect.title: Link another home
connect.working: Asking to link… this can take a few seconds.
copy.failed: Couldn't copy automatically. Select the text by hand.
fixed_by_config: Set by {{variable}} in the configuration file: you can see it here but not change it, because a restart would undo the change.
homes.empty: No linked homes yet. Once there is one, the members of the two homes will find each other in search and can follow each other.
homes.group.incoming: They asked to link with you
homes.help: This home asks the linked homes by itself whether they're there, every five minutes, even while nobody is looking at this page. The result is below. A home that doesn't answer needs nothing done by hand: it's tried again automatically, less and less often.
homes.title: Homes
key.help: It's the only thing to give to whoever wants to link with this home. It never changes: it comes from the instance's permanent identity and survives restarts, updates and restores from backup.
key.qr.note: Point a camera at this code to pick up the key instantly.
key.qr.title: QR code of the instance's key
key.ticket.help: In {{mode}} mode (home network) there is no global discovery: share this code instead, which includes the machine's current IP addresses.
key.ticket.label: Code with the current addresses
key.title: Your key
ping.failed: Something went wrong while checking whether it can be reached.
power.internet.done: EstiaNet is on, and reachable from outside too.
power.local.button: Switch on for the home network
power.local.done: EstiaNet is on, for the home network only.
power.local.working: Switching on for the home network…
power.modes: “Home network” uses nobody else's infrastructure, and works when the two homes are on the same Wi-Fi router. “From outside too” uses iroh's discovery servers and relays so that homes in different places can find each other.
power.off.failed: I couldn't switch EstiaNet off. Try again.
power.off.help: This home stops being findable and stops looking for the others. Links are not lost — they stay in the list and come back when you switch it on again — but while it is off no content crosses over and no message leaves for another home.
power.off.title: Switch off EstiaNet
power.on.failed: I couldn't switch EstiaNet on. Try again.
power.on.title: Switch on EstiaNet
purpose: Link this home to other ESTIA homes, and keep an eye on whether they answer.
reach.last_seen.direct: Last seen {{when}}, over a direct connection.
reach.never_answered: It has never answered so far.
row.accept.done: Link accepted: the two homes now talk to each other.
row.accept.title: Accept
row.block.confirm.text: Requests from this home will be refused at once, and open connections close. It stays in the list, among the blocked ones.
row.block.confirm.title: Block {{name}}?
row.block.done: Home blocked. Open connections have been cut.
row.block.title: Block this home
row.check.note: Without waiting for the next round
row.check.title: Check now
row.copy.note: The whole key, to the clipboard
row.copy.title: Copy the key
row.forget.confirm.text.blocked: It will no longer be blocked, and it will leave the list. If it wants, it can ask to link again.
row.forget.confirm.text.linked: The link ends and the home leaves the list. To link again, both sides will have to say yes again.
row.forget.confirm.text.request: The request you sent disappears from the list. You can always send it again.
row.forget.done: Done: the home has left the list.
row.refuse.title: Decline
row.resend.note: If it never arrived on the other side
row.resend.title: Send it again
